name: malformed_command__helix_arbiter
regression: Malformed numeric payload: a non-number in a velocity field is rejected like NaN, never coerced.
initial_conditions: Synthetic GO2 + HELIX run (6.5 s): /nav/cmd_vel at 20 Hz commands 0 m/s, then 0.15 m/s from t=2 s; HELIX hold published at 10 Hz, never asserted; odometry and lowstate at 20 Hz from the robot host, whose clock is 1.734 s ahead of the payload.
injected_fault: linear.x on /nav/cmd_vel is the string "fast" for 0.2 s from t=3.0 s.
